Define fixed-width genomic windows

Source: R/bins.R
make_fixed_bins.Rd

Create fixed-width genomic windows for selected chromosomes using chromosome information from a Seqinfo object. Chromosome names are normalised to the "chr"-prefixed style, both in seqinfo and in use_chr.

Usage

make_fixed_bins(seqinfo, bin_width, use_chr = c(1:19, "X"))

Arguments

seqinfo

A GenomeInfoDb::Seqinfo object containing chromosome names and lengths.

bin_width

A single positive integer specifying the window size (bp). We use 20000L.

use_chr

Chromosomes to use, with or without the "chr" prefix. Defaults to c(1:19, "X") (mm10 autosomes + X); use 1:19 for autosomes only.

Value

A GRanges of contiguous, non-overlapping windows [1 + (k-1)*bin_width, min(k*bin_width, seqlength)] per chromosome, with no metadata columns and with seqinfo set to the (chr-normalised) input seqinfo. The last window of each chromosome may be shorter.

Examples

si <- GenomeInfoDb::Seqinfo(c("chr1", "chr2"), c(105000L, 60000L))
make_fixed_bins(si, bin_width = 20000L, use_chr = 1:2)
#> GRanges object with 9 ranges and 0 metadata columns:
#>       seqnames        ranges strand
#>          <Rle>     <IRanges>  <Rle>
#>   [1]     chr1       1-20000      *
#>   [2]     chr1   20001-40000      *
#>   [3]     chr1   40001-60000      *
#>   [4]     chr1   60001-80000      *
#>   [5]     chr1  80001-100000      *
#>   [6]     chr1 100001-105000      *
#>   [7]     chr2       1-20000      *
#>   [8]     chr2   20001-40000      *
#>   [9]     chr2   40001-60000      *
#>   -------
#>   seqinfo: 2 sequences from an unspecified genome
